title: calipers probes
description: HTTP and DNS probes of calipers: success, latency quantiles and native histogram heatmaps per URL and per DNS server.

targets.expr: count(http_response_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: HTTP success
panels.description: Successful HTTP probes in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum (increase(http_response_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url", result="success"}[$__range])) / sum (increase(http_response_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Slowest HTTP p95
panels.description: p95 over the selected time range of the slowest URL.

targets.expr: max(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: DNS probes failing
panels.description: Server/domain/record type combinations whose last query failed.

targets.expr: count(dns_query_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: DNS success
panels.description: Successful DNS queries in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum (increase(dns_query_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server", result="success"}[$__range])) / sum (increase(dns_query_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Slowest DNS p95
panels.description: p95 over the selected time range of the slowest server.

targets.expr: max(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, server) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: HTTP probes
panels.description: Success and latency quantiles over the selected time range.

targets.expr: max by (host, method, url) (http_response_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"})
max by (host, method, url) (http_response_status_code{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"})

sum by (host, method, url) (increase(http_response_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url", result="success"}[$__range])) / sum by (host, method, url) (increase(http_response_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (host, method, url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, method, url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (host, method, url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__range])))
max by (host, method, url) (http_response_tls_cert_expiry_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}) - time()
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: HTTP failures
panels.description: Failed probes by result; only failing URLs appear.

targets.expr: sum by (host, url, result) (increase(http_response_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url", result!="success"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: DNS + TCP + TLS + full body. Hover a column for the distribution at that time.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_sum(sum by (url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__rate_interval]))) / histogram_count(sum by (url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", url=~"$url"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: DNS probes
panels.description: Success and latency quantiles over the selected time range.

targets.expr: max by (host, server, domain, record_type) (dns_query_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"})

sum by (host, server, domain, record_type) (increase(dns_query_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server", result="success"}[$__range])) / sum by (host, server, domain, record_type) (increase(dns_query_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (host, server, domain, record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, server, domain, record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (host, server, domain, record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__range])))
max by (host, server, domain, record_type) (dns_query_answers{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"})
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, server) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: DNS failures
panels.description: Failed queries by result; only failing servers appear.

targets.expr: sum by (host, server, result, rcode) (increase(dns_query_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server", result!="success"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: All domains and record types of this server. Replies only; timeouts are not included.

targets.expr: sum(rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_sum(sum by (record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]))) / histogram_count(sum by (record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))
